name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
summary: Captain Garran Vimes does not recognize the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe, and sends you to Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore, who looks after the records of the Theramore guard.

sections.title: Who Is Reethe?
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes cannot place the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Adjutant Tesoran keeps the records of the Theramore guard, covering its people as well as its equipment, and Vimes expects a look through those books to show who Reethe is.

faq.q: Who sends you to find out about Reethe?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes, who does not recognize the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe.

faq.q: Who keeps the Theramore guard's records?
faq.answer: Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore keeps them, covering the guard's people and its equipment.

faq.q: What can Adjutant Tesoran tell you?
faq.answer: Vimes expects Tesoran's books to show who Reethe is.

attribution: Classic quest text: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
